item.title: Why high prices aren't ending America's diesel reliance
item.description: The simplest and most affordable response to record diesel prices is to use less of it. Diesel remains deeply entrenched in the economy.

item.title: Senate control depends on unwanted nominees
item.description: Senate Majority Leader John Thune and Minority Leader Chuck Schumer face midterm challenges with nominees they did not want.

item.title: Wall Street prepares for AI's aftermath
item.description: Major US banks are working to prevent AI worst-case scenarios and preparing for the aftermath of a catastrophe, Axios has learned.

item.title: Religious left targets red-state conservatives
item.description: Democrats in two deep-red states are challenging the religious right's dominance by centering their Christian faith in their campaigns.
